feeds.description: Blog posts about each artist featured in our Creative Matters podcast, as well as other news and events. Creative Matters is an award winning business providing creative, educational opportunities to enrich the lives of our children, educators, artists and community.

feeds.title: The Poi Room Ltd Blog
feeds.description: Sign up to get the latest on sales, new releases and more. We wanted to share the uniqueness of Aotearoa's artists with the world but also 'make a positive difference' to all those we meet.With a positive attitude over the years, we have become enablers for the art world!!!

feeds.title: Renee Walden Art Blog
feeds.description: The blog for New Zealand artist Renee Walden -mixed media abstract landscapes, watercolour paintings and painting workshops.

feeds.title: infonews.co.nz » New Zealand Art news
feeds.description: New Zealand Art news from infonews.co.nz. infonews.co.nz is a nation-wide local news website for New Zealand which allows any member of the community to publish news and photos.

feeds.title: Sherril Jennings Blog
feeds.description: My name is Sherril Jennings and I am a New Zealand artist. My art doesn't fit neatly in a box. I'm not an oil painter, I'm not a knitter and I'm not a sculpturist yet I do a little of all of those things, creating where the inspiration takes me, feeling my way as I go.

feeds.title: Artbay Gallery
feeds.description: News from Artbay Gallery. Buy contemporary New Zealand art online by award-winning New Zealand artists with exclusive works available only from Artbay Gallery, Queenstown, New Zealand.

feeds.title: New Zealand Art Print News
feeds.description: News and articles about art prints & NZ artists from New Zealand Fine Prints. For over five decades New Zealand Fine Prints has been making it easy for Kiwis to buy high quality art prints from Aotearoa and around the world.

feeds.title: ORA Gallery Blog
feeds.description: Halfway down Allen Street, nestled within the epicenter of Wellington's cultural quarter, you'll find ORA Gallery. Home to one of the city's best collections of contemporary New Zealand Art and Design.

feeds.title: endemicworld Blog
feeds.description: Articles and interviews on the latest exhibitions, artists and new work. endemicworld is an art gallery founded in 2007 by Elliot Alexander. Our aim is to connect our customers with the art they love and guide artists to creative and commercial success.
